transcript:
Speaker A (AI Robot): Hello, where are you right now? 
Speaker B (Man): I am at temple. 
Speaker A (AI Robot): Hello, what is your name? 
Speaker B (Man): My name is Ramesh. 
Speaker A (AI Robot): How old are you? 
Speaker B (Man): I have 45. 
Speaker A (AI Robot): "I have 45" nahi, "I'm 45 years old" hota hai. [Not "I have 45", it is "I'm 45 years old".] 
Speaker B (Man): Okay, okay. I'm 45 years old. 
Speaker A (AI Robot): Where are you from? 
Speaker B (Man): I am Uttar Pradesh. 
Speaker A (AI Robot): "I am Uttar Pradesh" nahi, "I'm from Uttar Pradesh" hoga. [Not "I am Uttar Pradesh", it should be "I'm from Uttar Pradesh".] 
Speaker B (Man): Oh, theek hai, theek hai. Mujhe English acche se nahi aati. [Oh, okay, okay. I don't know English very well.] 
Speaker A (AI Robot): Koi problem nahi. AI Teacher try kiya? [No problem. Have you tried an AI Teacher?] 
Speaker B (Man): Woh toh mehnge hote honge na? [But those must be expensive, right?] 
Speaker A (AI Robot): Bilkul nahi. Bas ek rupaye ka trial. Chai se bhi sasta hai. Hindi mein lessons deke English bolna sikhate hain. Roz experts ke saath jo seekha, mere saath aake practice karo. Main kabhi tumhara mazaak nahi udaunga. [Not at all. Just a one-rupee trial. Cheaper than tea. They teach English speaking through Hindi lessons. Practice what you learn daily with experts by talking to me. I will never make fun of you.] 
Speaker B (Man): Par time nahi milta. [But I don't get time.] 
Speaker A (AI Robot): Roz ki sirf 15 se 20 minute ki practice kaafi hai. Bilkul confident ho jaoge. [Just 15 to 20 minutes of daily practice is enough. You will become completely confident.] 
Speaker B (Man): Kaise join karu? [How do I join?] 
Speaker A (AI Robot): Yeh install ka button dabao aur English Seekho app install karo. Sirf 15 dino mein tumhe improvement dikhne lagegi. Chalo, shuru ho jao. [Press this install button and install the English Seekho app. You will start seeing improvement in just 15 days. Come on, get started.] 
Speaker C (Voiceover): Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An AI robot avatar converses with a man at a temple, correcting his English grammar mistakes in real-time. The robot introduces the 'English Seekho' app, highlighting its affordable 1-rupee trial, Hindi-to-English lessons, and judgment-free practice environment. The ad concludes with a call to action prompting users to install the app for visible improvement in 15 days.
